sources.title: KV Cache Pruning for LLM Serving
sources.abstract: ML serving note: KV-cache paging and speculative decoding cut transformer p99 latency on long-context batches. This is model inference tuning, not OS page-cache tuning.

sources.title: Raft Leader Election Notes
sources.abstract: Systems note: minority Raft partitions cannot elect a leader without majority quorum; isolated nodes step down until the partition heals.

sources.title: Secret Rotation Playbook
sources.abstract: Security note: issue a new OAuth client secret, dual-accept during overlap window, revoke the old secret, and audit anomalous token grants.

sources.title: Pricing Experiment Memo
sources.abstract: Product note: annual-plan discount lifted signup conversion by 4.2% with flat ARPU; recommend rollout to all self-serve regions.
